newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran says tyre output up 30 percent since March.
newsitem.headline: Iran says tyre output up 30 percent since March.

text.p: Iran's tyre production has increased 30 percent since March, an Iranian official said on Thursday.

Mahmoud Edalatian, the top official in charge of chemical industries at the industry ministry, said tyre output had risen 30 percent since March 20, the start of the Iranian year, over the same period last year, Iran's news agency IRNA reported.
Production would reach a total of 150,000 tonnes by the end of the year on March 20, 1997, he said.
Tyre exports had fetched Iran some $60 million in the current year. The report did not give comparative figures.
He expressed hope production would reach 180,000 tonnes of tyres next year, IRNA said.
